description: This file declares the ObservedOperators class, which provides static methods to check if an operator is observed and to retrieve the list of unobserved operators within the ATen core dispatch system.

classes.name: ObservedOperators
classes.description: Provides static methods for querying observed status of operators and retrieving unobserved operator list in the ATen dispatch system.

methods.name: isObserved
methods.description: Checks if a given operator name is observed.

methods.name: getUnobservedOperatorList
methods.description: Returns a set of operator names that are currently unobserved.
